parameter_location: Published Table 1 (p774); Sec3 (p773); force convention Eqs2-7; Fig7 p776 up-milling labels digitized in existing repository CSV
evaluation: Only27 visually resolved rows from fixed-seed32-row stratified audit; ambiguous and boundary-curve markers not used as labels. All resolved labels retained regardless of model agreement. No parameter or threshold fitting. rho<1 predicts stable. Do not extrapolate this subset's agreement to all516 points or real machining.
uncertainty: Same-assistant visual review, some prior exposure; not independent double-blind annotation. Numeric coordinates inherited, not independently redigitized. Original516-row CSV contains confirmed label errors and boundary markers; old68.41% is agreement with that CSV only. No new cutting experiment or population accuracy estimate.
limits: Stationary diagonal modal parameters; paper reports speed-dependent frequency and likely cutting-coefficient variation. No process damping, tool runout, mode coupling in measured FRF, or nonlinear contact. Constant coefficients not fitted to improve accuracy.
